versions.subject: fix: FPs with Important Scheduled Task Deleted
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID:
        - 4699 # Task Deleted Event
        - 4701 # Task Disabled Event
    TaskName|contains:
        # Add more important tasks>
        - '\Windows\SystemRestore\SR'
        - '\Windows\Windows Defender\'
        - '\Windows\BitLocker'
        - '\Windows\WindowsBackup\'
        - '\Windows\WindowsUpdate\'
        - '\Windows\UpdateOrchestrator\'
        - '\Windows\ExploitGuard'
filter:
    SubjectUserName|endswith: '$'  # False positives during upgrades of Defender, where its tasks get removed and added
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: EventID IN (4699, 4701) TaskName IN ("*\\Windows\\SystemRestore\\SR*", "*\\Windows\\Windows Defender\\*", "*\\Windows\\BitLocker*", "*\\Windows\\WindowsBackup\\*", "*\\Windows\\WindowsUpdate\\*", "*\\Windows\\UpdateOrchestrator\\*", "*\\Windows\\ExploitGuard*") NOT SubjectUserName="*$"
